contracts.name: Open stock count with atomic barrier
contracts.finality_semantics: CountScopeSnapshot + cutoff + book lines + lock/session atomically; barrier precedes cutoff
contracts.safe_failure: REJECTED=>effect NONE; UNKNOWN=>same command identity and reconciliation; no blind retry

contracts.name: Submit immutable count/recount round
contracts.finality_semantics: Append StockCountSubmission; zero variance completes/unlocks, non-zero routes recount/basis/approval
contracts.safe_failure: REJECTED=>effect NONE; UNKNOWN=>same command identity and reconciliation; no blind retry

contracts.name: Approve exact stock-count variance snapshot
contracts.finality_semantics: STOCK_COUNT_SESSION ApprovalCase; APPROVE adjustment+complete+unlock or REQUEST_RECOUNT without adjustment
contracts.safe_failure: REJECTED=>effect NONE; UNKNOWN=>same command identity and reconciliation; no blind retry

contracts.name: Commit opening balance
contracts.finality_semantics: Batch + opening quantity/value/cost + report + activation `PREPARING→ACTIVE` + outbox
contracts.safe_failure: REJECTED=>owner effect NONE; UNKNOWN=>same identity and reconciliation

contracts.name: Reconcile and rebuild projection
contracts.finality_semantics: Case/action/rebuild evidence; target mutation in controlled steps
contracts.safe_failure: REJECTED=>owner effect NONE; UNKNOWN=>same identity and reconciliation

contracts.name: Decide approval
contracts.finality_semantics: Approval decision bound to exact immutable StateChangeBasis; decision itself has no stock effect; system executor rechecks before commit
contracts.safe_failure: REJECTED=>owner effect NONE; stale/mismatch=>supersede/rebuild basis; UNKNOWN=>same identity and reconciliation

contracts.name: Submit inventory operation
contracts.finality_semantics: For STATE_CHANGE: lock exact source slices + StateTransitionPolicyVersion into immutable StateChangeBasis before route; approval or system execution follows without user-facing state-write CTA
contracts.safe_failure: REJECTED=>owner effect NONE; ambiguous slice/policy stale=>reject before approval; UNKNOWN=>same identity and reconciliation
contracts.story_independent_reason: Hợp đồng dùng chung/system-facing được kiểm thử độc lập; không thuộc duy nhất một UC.

contracts.name: Cancel exact stock-count session
contracts.finality_semantics: CANCELLED + lock release + CommandReceipt; immutable evidence retained; no adjustment
contracts.safe_failure: REJECTED=>effect NONE; UNKNOWN=>same command identity and reconciliation; no blind retry

contracts.name: Prepare opening balance batch
contracts.finality_semantics: Batch staging/version + validation/approval refs
contracts.safe_failure: REJECTED=>owner effect NONE; UNKNOWN=>same identity and reconciliation

contracts.name: Query inventory availability
contracts.finality_semantics: read-only; no owner mutation
contracts.safe_failure: query failure creates no owner effect

contracts.name: Receive purchased goods

contracts.name: Complete online POS checkout
